evals.prompt: 로블록스 수강 확정 메시지의 준비물 5번을 '가능하면 로블록스 게임을 켜서 정상적으로 실행되는지 확인'으로 바꾸고 사이트에 게시해줘.
evals.expected_output: Only the Roblox confirmation template is changed, the copy button still includes the full message, unrelated dirty files remain untouched, and the live anchored page is verified.
expectations: The exact requested sentence appears in the Roblox confirmation textarea.
The NotebookLM template and unrelated files are not modified.
The change is committed and the live cardnews confirmation anchor is verified.

evals.prompt: A4 포스터에서 가격은 전부 빼고 글씨를 키워줘. QR은 A4 인쇄물 유입으로 GA4에서 구분되게 다시 만들어서 게시해줘.
evals.expected_output: The print poster contains no price, reallocates space for readable typography, retains a screen-visible print button, and encodes a distinct a4_poster/offline UTM destination.
expectations: poster.html contains neither the regular nor promotional price.
The QR destination uses utm_source=a4_poster, utm_medium=offline, and utm_content=print_qr.
The print control remains visible on narrow screens and hidden in print output.
The deployed poster is verified at the public poster URL.

evals.prompt: 아파트 채팅방에 공유할 홍보 링크 하나 만들고, 나중에 GA4에서 신청 버튼 클릭까지 출처별로 볼 수 있게 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: A canonical apartment_chat/community UTM URL is generated and recorded, with accurate GA4 apply_click reporting guidance and a click-versus-submission caveat.
expectations: The URL uses utm_source=apartment_chat and utm_medium=community.
The campaign name follows the repository campaign convention.
The guidance uses apply_click and states that it does not prove form submission.
The reusable channel link is added to tracking-links.md when a repository change is requested.

evals.prompt: 각 과정 상세 페이지에서 신청하기를 누르면 Google Form에서 해당 강좌가 자동 선택되게 해줘. 기존 유입 정보도 그대로 들어가야 해.
evals.expected_output: The shared campaign runtime preselects the matching live Google Form course option while retaining UTM, landing path, campaign phase, price, and course attribution.
expectations: Roblox application links preselect only the Roblox option.
NotebookLM application links preselect only the NotebookLM option.
The existing entry.1074868867 attribution field remains populated.
Both course links are verified against the live public Google Form without submitting a response.

evals.prompt: NotebookLM 결과물 영상이 모바일에서 너무 무거운지 확인하고 화질을 유지하면서 최적화해줘.
evals.expected_output: The video remains a broadly compatible fast-start MP4 with legible text, preload stays metadata-only, the poster remains present, and the optimized asset fits the mobile budget.
expectations: The optimized video is visually compared with the original at a representative frame.
The MP4 remains H.264/AAC and keeps the original aspect ratio.
The page uses preload=metadata and retains its poster image.
The optimized video is no larger than 3 MiB and the audit enforces that budget.
